reason: I like that my data stays on my own machine, but I am looking for an internship and do not want to set up a server or figure out API keys just to search and track jobs. I would stick with the sites and spreadsheet I already know for now.
objection: How much technical setup and ongoing maintenance will I have to do on my own laptop?
would_change_my_mind: A simple guided setup I can complete on my laptop in a few minutes, with a clear list of what data stays local and what any connected provider receives.
